easy.explanation: The first verse says that Moab rebelled against Israel after Ahab died.
easy.q: Who rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab?

easy.explanation: Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber in Samaria.
Ahaziah sent messengers to enquire of Baal-zebub.
easy.q: To whom did Ahaziah send messengers?

answers: To learn whether he would recover
medium.explanation: He wanted to know whether he would recover from his disease.
medium.q: Why did Ahaziah send messengers to Baal-zebub?

medium.explanation: Moab rebelled by rising against Israel’s rule.
medium.q: In the KJV, what does “rebelled” mean in this passage?

answers: He did not go to war
He sought an idol instead of the God of Israel
medium.explanation: Elijah asked whether there was no God in Israel to enquire of.
medium.q: What was the main criticism of Ahaziah’s action?

answers: His appeal was the reason he would not recover
His appeal caused Moab to rebel
His appeal caused the messengers to return
challenge.explanation: Because he sought Baal-zebub, Elijah announced that Ahaziah would surely die.
challenge.q: What was the connection between Ahaziah’s appeal to Baal-zebub and the judgment pronounced against him?

answers: Is it not because there is not a God in Israel?
challenge.explanation: The question showed that Ahaziah had no reason to seek a foreign idol.
challenge.q: What repeated question in Elijah’s message emphasized the seriousness of Ahaziah’s action?

challenge.explanation: After delivering the message, Elijah departed.
challenge.q: What can be inferred from the statement, “And Elijah departed,” after he delivered the LORD’s message?

paragraphs.title: The Messengers Return and Identify Elijah

easy.explanation: The messengers turned back and reported to Ahaziah.
easy.q: What did the messengers do after meeting the man?

answers: An old man in a robe
A hairy man wearing a leather girdle
An armed man carrying a sword
easy.explanation: They said he was hairy and wore a girdle of leather about his loins.
easy.q: How did the messengers describe the man?

easy.explanation: The king said, “It is Elijah the Tishbite.”
easy.q: Whom did the king identify from this description?

answers: To identify who had spoken to them
To learn who had rebelled against Moab
medium.explanation: The king asked what kind of man he was and identified him from their answer.
medium.q: Why did Ahaziah ask the messengers about the man they had met?

medium.explanation: A girdle is a belt, and this one was made of leather.

answers: They described his appearance and clothing
They brought him before the king
medium.explanation: The king recognized Elijah from the description of his appearance.
medium.q: How did the messengers’ answer lead to Elijah’s identification?

answers: That he was hairy and wore a leather girdle
That he spoke with the king
challenge.explanation: These distinctive details led the king to identify him as Elijah.
challenge.q: Which detail in the messengers’ description was most useful for identifying the man?

answers: They did not hear what he said
challenge.explanation: The man told them to turn again to the king and deliver the LORD’s message.
challenge.q: What can be learned from the messengers’ returning to the king instead of continuing to Ekron?

answers: Both said that Ahaziah would die
Both said that Moab would rebel
Both said that Elijah was sick
challenge.explanation: Both messages announced that Ahaziah would surely die.
challenge.q: What connection is there between the man’s words to the messengers and the message reported to Ahaziah?

paragraphs.title: The First Two Captains and Fire from Heaven

easy.explanation: Each group consisted of a captain of fifty with his fifty men.
easy.q: How many men were in each of the first two groups sent to Elijah?

answers: On the top of a hill
easy.explanation: The first captain found Elijah sitting on the top of a hill.
Fire came down from heaven and consumed the captain and his fifty.
easy.q: What came down from heaven after Elijah spoke?

medium.q: What did the first two captains command Elijah to do?

answers: A captain who ruled for fifty years
A man who was fifty years old
medium.explanation: The passage describes a captain together with his fifty men.

answers: Because the captains commanded him to come down
medium.explanation: Elijah said that if he was a man of God, fire should consume them.
medium.q: Why did Elijah call for fire from heaven?

answers: Both commanded Elijah to come down
challenge.explanation: Both captains spoke to Elijah with a command rather than a plea.
challenge.q: What was similar about the behavior of the first two captains?

challenge.explanation: Fire came down after the first captain and again after the second.
challenge.q: What does the repetition of the fire coming down emphasize?

answers: He placed God’s authority above the king’s demand
He wanted to become a captain
challenge.explanation: Elijah acted according to God’s authority rather than obeying the captains.
challenge.q: What does Elijah’s response show about his attitude toward the king’s command?

paragraphs.title: The Third Captain, the Prophecy, and Ahaziah’s Death

easy.explanation: The third captain fell on his knees and besought Elijah.
easy.q: How did the third captain approach Elijah?

answers: He went down with the third captain to the king
easy.explanation: Elijah arose and went down with the captain unto the king.
easy.q: What did Elijah do after the angel of the LORD spoke to him?

answers: He died according to the word of the LORD
easy.explanation: The text says that he died according to the word of the LORD.

answers: The captain acted humbly and pleaded for mercy
The captain promised Elijah a gift
medium.explanation: The captain pleaded for his life and the lives of his men, and the angel told Elijah to go with him.
medium.q: Why did Elijah agree to go down with the third captain?

answers: Let my life be spared and valued
medium.explanation: The captain asked that his life and the lives of his men be spared.
medium.q: What does the expression “let my life be precious” mean?

answers: Ahaziah came down from his bed
Ahaziah died and did not come down from his bed
medium.explanation: The prophecy said Ahaziah would die, and he did die.
medium.q: What was the result of the prophecy Elijah repeated to the king?

answers: He knelt and pleaded instead of commanding Elijah
He did not know where Elijah was
challenge.explanation: The third captain approached Elijah humbly and asked for mercy.
challenge.q: What was the main difference between the third captain and the first two captains?

answers: He died according to the word of the LORD spoken by Elijah
He died only because Moab rebelled
The prophecy was canceled after the fire fell
challenge.explanation: The text specifically says that Ahaziah died according to the LORD’s word.
challenge.q: What connection does the chapter show between the prophecy and Ahaziah’s death?

challenge.explanation: Jehoram reigned in his stead because Ahaziah had no son.
challenge.q: Who reigned in Ahaziah’s place after his death?
